scope: Prompt S8 - Hardware device trust registry, expiring trust lifecycle, manager step-up authentication, server-side session administration, remote forced logout (single, user, device, global emergency), Super-Admin emergency access (Break-Glass) with owner alerts and duration cap, and kiosk mode route lockdown with Arabic recovery workflows.

gateEvidence.canonicalTestSuitePassed: Master test runner exit 0: 48/48 suites, 426 tests passing 100% cleanly.
gateEvidence.hardwareDeviceRegistryWithExpiringTrust: Devices enrolled with hardware/OS/browser metadata; trust is explicit with default expiration and step-up manager PIN verification.
gateEvidence.cashierTrustGrantImmunity: Cashiers and regular staff cannot grant device trust or modify kiosk mode configurations (strictly blocked with 403 FORBIDDEN / TRUST_GRANT_DENIED).
gateEvidence.trustedDeviceZeroPermissionBypass: A trusted device never bypasses user role permissions, active shift requirements, drawer bounds, or audit ledger tracking.
gateEvidence.granularRemoteSessionRevocation: Admins can remotely revoke individual sessions, all sessions for a user, or all sessions on a device with instant WebSocket termination (close code 4001) and DB invalidation.
gateEvidence.globalEmergencyRevocation: Global emergency session purge forces all active sessions to disconnect and require re-authentication with verified manager step-up PIN.
gateEvidence.credentialRotationSessionInvalidation: Rotating PIN or deactivating account immediately terminates all active sessions across all devices.
gateEvidence.superAdminBreakGlassEmergencyAccess: Break-glass access requires external ticket reference, justification reason, step-up PIN authentication, enforces strict time limit (max 120m), and produces CRITICAL security alert and audit ledger rows.
gateEvidence.emergencyAccessOwnerAlerting: Emergency activations immediately alert venue owners and managers via in-app notifications and security alerts.
gateEvidence.kioskModeRouteLockdownAndArabicRecovery: Dedicated KDS/POS kiosk terminals are locked to authorized station routes with navigation shields and Arabic recovery message displayed upon session termination.
